kills.property: For any input where the loop calls succeed (no revert), the reference always returns true, but the mutant returns false.
If the call to caddress succeeds for every recipient in the _tos array then the reference contract returns true on any c
kills.change_summary: Replace `require(_tos.length > 0);` with `require(_tos.length > 1);` so calls with exactly one recipient revert instead of succeeding.

kills.property: Calling transfer with an empty _tos array must revert; the mutant allows it to succeed.
kills.change_summary: Delete the `require(_tos.length > 0);` check so empty `_tos` arrays no longer cause a revert, changing the outcome from failure to success.

kills.property: Correct C reverts the entire transfer if any sub-call fails, while the mutant silently ignores failures and returns true
kills.change_summary: Delete the `revert();` inside the failure check so failed sub-calls are silently ignored and the function succeeds instead of reverting.
